name: wbllike
expr: nL_b = wbllike([1, 2], x); nL_c = wbllike([1, 2], x, cens); nL_f = wbllike([1, 2], x, [], freq); nL_cf = wbllike([1, 2], x, cens, freq); nL_s0 = wbllike([0, 2], x); nL_kn = wbllike([1, -1], x);
comment: Sig: nL = wbllike([scale shape], x[, cens, freq]). Weibull(a, b). Uncensored: -log(b) + b·log(a) - (b-1)·log(x) + (x/a)^b. Censored: (x/a)^b. With optional freq weights. Edges: scale<=0 or shape<=0 -> NaN (was Inf); x_i <= 0 -> NaN. Empty data: numkit returns 0 (consistent with our *like family); MATLAB errors `DATA must be a vector` — convention difference, not in fingerprint. AVAR (2-output form) deferred.
